|arg= global

|gr1= AI Behaviour

|descr= Returns the behaviour of the individual unit, this is why it only accepts [[Object]] as the argument. For Arma 3 behaviour explanation see [[Arma_3_AI_Behavior]]

|s1= [[behaviour]] unit

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|r1= [[String]] - one of:
* "CARELESS"
* "SAFE"
* "AWARE"
* "COMBAT"
* "STEALTH"
* "ERROR" (Since {{GVI|Arma3|1.78}} when used on empty vehicles and such)

|x1= <sqf>
_soldier setBehaviour "CARELESS";
_b = behaviour _soldier; // returns "CARELESS"
</sqf>
